biotools.summary: FLEXR GUI is a plugin for Coot that provides a graphical user interface for multi-conformer modeling of proteins, automating the separation of conformational signal from noise. It allows seamless integration of FLEXR models into the crystallographic modeling and validation pipeline within Coot.
